_schema.bridge: Every id here has matching display text in en.json (and other locale files). logic.json is language-independent.
_schema.conditionLogic: Structured precondition. Predicates: recorded/notRecorded(logId); time{lt,lte,gt,gte,min,max}; timeSinceMarker{symbol,...}; timeMarkerReached(symbol); countRecorded{anyOf[logId],gte/lt/...}; tally{entry,gte}; tallyCompare{left,op,right}; visited/notVisited(fileCode); voteTally('yeaWinsOrTie'|'nayWins'); votedNay[characterId]; eerilySilentCount{gte}; noResolution; allDefeated; perDefeatedInvestigator; atOtherCity; random; scenarioState(enum); default. Combinators: all[],any[],not{}.
_schema.scenarioState: Per-scenario board outcomes the planner sets, e.g. seeingRedActive, reachedKeyFirst, thorneHasKey, thorneDefeated, winHoldingKey, nullified, failAct3, defeatedAct1or2, winCooperating, winV2, winV3Sirry, defeatV1, defeatV2, defeatV3, winBlewWhistle, winThrewWhistle, survivedBlewWhistle, survivedThrewWhistle, desiReal, desiImpostor.
_schema.voteTally: Tally member votes from finale voteTable: yea=wants you killed, nay=wants you spared, abstain/silent=neither. A tie counts as yea. 'overthrow' and 'join' additionally require their named trio all voted nay and the player opting in.
_schema.effects: See en.json legend.effects for human descriptions. record/crossOff/tally reference campaignLog ids via entryId. note/variable-xp carry textRef/amountRef into en.effectText.
_schema.identifiers: Proper nouns are ids resolved via en.json: keyId->en.keys, bearer/voter ids->en.characters (the literal 'investigator' means the player's chosen investigator, not a character), locationIds->en.locations. file.keyAtStakeId and unlock.locationIds use the same ids.
_schema.locations: Registry: locationId -> {fileCodes:[...]}. Resolve a location's three display facets without duplication: city NAME = en.locations[locId]; PAGE CODE(s) = the fileCodes themselves; SCENARIO NAME(s) = en.files[fileCode].title. (london maps to several files because the prologue, the Foundation interlude, and the revisit all occur there.)
_schema.timeMarkers: Time-track markers. symbol is what's printed in the time box; id bridges to en.timeMarkers for a succinct label; reportOptionId points to the StatusReports option whose effects/fullText fire when reached (null for δ, which is a silent timer used by the Dr. Irawan deadline). box = the printed box on the 35-box track where this marker sits and fires (α7 ε10 β15 ζ20 γ24 ω35); markers WITHOUT a box (Θ/ψ/δ) are written onto the track at runtime by statusMarker effects and fire when that written box is reached. Flags: unlocksFinale (β makes Tunguska travellable), forcesFinale (ω sends you straight to the finale). See timeTrack for the track length.
_schema.sideStories: Standalone scenarios playable at green side-story nodes. timeCost = the side story's normal XP cost, spent as time here instead. grantsKeyId/bearer present when the side story awards a campaign Key (Fortune and Folly grants The Wellspring of Fortune). Product display names are in en.sideStoryProducts.
_schema.connections: Undirected adjacency from the official ArkhamCards map data. locations[id].connections lists directly-travellable neighbors (1 time each). wrapEdges cross the Pacific seam: the 'west' node runs off the LEFT edge to its westSeam point (x=0), and the 'east' node runs off the RIGHT edge to its eastSeam point (x=1); both seam points share a latitude (y) so the line reads as continuous wrap-around. Render each wrap leg as two half-curves (west->westSeam and east->eastSeam), not a straight line across the map.
_schema.reachableInVersions: On a resolution option in a scenario that has a scenario_version decision: the version option id(s) in which this resolution can occur. Use it to filter the resolution dropdown by the selected version. Absent = reachable regardless of version.
_schema.isNoResolution: true on a resolution option that represents the 'no resolution reached' (all investigators resigned/were defeated) outcome. The campaign guide routes no-resolution to these; some scenarios fold it into a numbered resolution (e.g. Dogs of War R3/R4/R7 by version, Sanguine Shadows R3, Dealings R6).
_schema.gatesResolutions: On a scenario_version decision: true if the version played restricts which resolutions are reachable (use options' reachableInVersions to filter). false if all versions share the same finishing act/agenda and can reach the same resolutions. Verified against the campaign's act/agenda cards: Dogs of War gates (each version's act routes to different resolutions: v.I->R1->R8, v.II->R2, v.III->R5/R6, with no-resolution R3/R4/R7 by version); Dancing Mad and Congress of the Keys do NOT gate (shared finishers route to R1/R2 regardless of version).
_schema.requires: Plannable precondition for a resolution: predicates the planner can evaluate from the player's planned CHOICES, time, and version. Use it to HIDE resolutions that can't be reached given the plan. null = no choice/time gate. Predicates: recorded/notRecorded(logId), choseOption/notChoseOption(decision option id), time{...}, plus all/any/not. (Version gating stays in reachableInVersions; a UI hides a resolution if requires fails OR—when the scenario gatesResolutions—the chosen version isn't in reachableInVersions.)
_schema.playOutcome: How the session must go for this resolution: 'win' | 'partial' (completed but suboptimal, e.g. a Key lost to the Coterie) | 'loss' | 'noResolution'. NOT plannable — the UI should show these as outcome-dependent rather than hide them.
_schema.choseOption: Predicate referencing an upstream decision option id the planner selected (and notChoseOption for its negation). Used where a choice gates resolutions without setting a campaign-log entry (e.g. Sanguine Shadows believe/refuse, Without a Trace blow/throw the whistle).
_schema.achievements: id bridges to en.achievements for name/description. detect = the machine rule a planner uses to decide whether a plan earns the achievement; kinds: visitFile{fileCode,maxEntryTime?}, resolution{fileCode,optionId}, version{fileCode,optionId} (the scenario_version/finale-version option that fired), finaleJudgment{judgmentId}, timeCap{maxTime}, chaos{token,count}, epilogue{optionId}, visitLocations{locationIds}, allKeys, difficulty{difficulty}, tableFeat (pure in-play feat, no routing). inSession:true => routing only POSITIONS the player; the feat itself is unverifiable by the planner. planning:false => not a single-run planning goal (key collection / difficulty).

mapImage.note: position {x,y} are fractions of width/height (0-1). markerType: scenario(blue star)/locked(red dot)/sideStory(green ring)/secret. positionConfidence 'approx' = eyeballed, verify in an editor.

curve._doc: Direction-independent: order the two endpoints canonically (endpoint ids sorted A<B), take perpendicular of A->B, offset control point by sign*k*chordLength. Same arc regardless of travel direction; reverse the sampled points if you traverse B->A (for arrowheads).

routing._doc: Planned course = uniform quadratic beziers between consecutive route nodes over locations[*].connections. Control point per curve.{k,sign}; flip or retune individual edges via routing.edgeOverrides keyed by the two location ids sorted and joined with '|'. Wrap legs (see wrapEdges) draw as two half-curves to the seam anchors. Expedited Ticket leg: dashed, warp glyph, timeCost 0.

wrap._doc: Each wrap half (node -> seam point) is a quadratic bezier bowing UPWARD: control = midpoint(node,seam) with y reduced by bowUpK*|node.x - seam.x|. Seam points sit on the left/right image edge (x=0 or 1).

timeTrack.note: The global time track is 35 boxes. Printed Greek markers fire their status report when their box is filled; written markers (Θ/ψ/δ) are placed onto the track at runtime by statusMarker effects and fire when reached. ω is the final box and forces the finale.
